name: Shoo!
tip: Place the cat next to the mouse to scare it into the hole.

name: Chain Reaction
tip: Dogs don't scare mice, but they scare cats. Place the dog next to the cat, and the cat will scare the mouse.

name: Bear Necessities
tip: Bears scare dogs. Place the bear to start a chain: bear scares dog, dog scares cat, cat scares mouse.

name: Lion's Den
tip: New animal: the lion! Lions scare bears.

name: The Keep
tip: New animal: the elephant! Elephants scare lions, and they're scared of mice.

name: Flour Bin
tip: New: kitchen counters! Animals can't run through them, so watch out for the counters.

name: Map Table
tip: New: bookshelves! Like the counters, animals can't run through them.
